regime_context: The Hong Kong theme detector is in a narrow, defensive leadership structure: only 4 of 17 themes clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate, led by Energy (H-shares) and High-Dividend Blue Chips. Energy holds the top rank with strong durability and breadth but is NOT scorable via a proxy ETF, so no high-conviction directional call can be responsibly graded on it. The validated edge here is the trend gate (drawdown control), not return forecasting, so any lean must be conditional rather than predictive.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is scorable (3033.HK) and sits at rank 14 with a deeply negative composite score (-1.028) and fails the absolute-trend eligibility gate. The hurst_tag is mean-revert, which for a trend-gated discipline means this theme should not be the focus of upside risk. The negative crowding_z (-0.89) only reflects outflow/abandonment, not a contrarian buy setup. The lean is a directional avoidance until the trend gate re-qualifies the theme.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting themes can stage sharp snap-back rallies on policy or earnings surprises, and the Hong Kong market is historically sensitive to China stimulus headlines. Avoiding a deeply discounted, scorable theme leaves no expression on the highest-beta recovery trade if sentiment flips.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK clears and holds its absolute-trend gate (eligibility flips to true) and its composite score rises above 0 before the check-by date
